ns2:course.label: Translating Your IB Degree Into Career Success
ns2:course.description: Explores what jobs and industries are available to Integrative Biology graduates, and what it takes to be successful on the job market. Experts will serve as resources, including biology alumni that have been in your shoes and are now professionals in a range of fields. The final project will be a real-life application of the course material, with every component meant to further your career goals. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: For students pursuing IB-related careers.
